title: Local model: classify an unreachable endpoint and fall back to the next row
lead: *Proposed:* when a `-local` launcher cannot reach the server, ork moves to the next matrix row (adj 156) instead of pausing. This is the part of S301 that needs a measured sample (adj 23, 77).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
- The Claude classifier returns unclassified for every non-success exit (`internal/agent/claude/classify.go:19-33`), and an unclassified exit stops for the owner (`internal/engine/ledger.go:45-46`). An unreachable local server would pause the run.
- No sample of an unreachable endpoint exists in `testdata/vendors/*`.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- Each launcher's captured server-down output is a fixture under `testdata/vendors/` and classifies as an error that adj 156 treats as fall-back-eligible.
- A denied or other unclassified local exit still stops for the owner.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. The owner captures one server-down sample per launcher (claude-local, codex-local, grok-local) and puts it in the fixtures; stop and ask if a sample is missing.
2. Add the narrowest classifier rule per vendor that matches the sample.
3. Update the docs.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- Samples exist for all three launchers.
- `go test ./...`, `go vet ./...`, `gofmt -l .`, `slicer check`, `adj lint`.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: - Branch and worktree per AGENTS.md; no commit until the owner approves.
